headline: Brazil's Lula Reaffirms Fiscal Responsibility and Minimizes Public Debt
summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva reiterated his commitment to fiscal responsibility during a National Energy Policy Council meeting in Brasília.
why: Presidential statements on fiscal targets influence sovereign credit risk assessments and investor confidence in Brazilian fixed-income and equity markets.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Fiscal policy commitments shape sovereign risk perceptions.
